recipes.name: Smokey Lentil Stew with Aioli
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and salt, and cook until lightly caramelized, about 15 minutes. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pan.
Once caramelized, add the garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika, and cumin. Cook for 1 more minute. Stir throughout.
Cook uncovered at a simmer until the rice is cooked through, around 15 minutes. Stir often. Taste and adjust the seasonings as needed.
Divide the stew into bowls and top off with dollops of aioli. Garnish as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
